items.title: Product of the Day — Suffering Jukebox
items.text:
The Suffering Jukebox appears to be an ordinary vinyl record player at first glance. However, when inserted into the machine's slot, specially crafted records imbue listeners with specific types of emotional anguish tailored by expert sonic therapists. A carefully curated selection ensures users experience catharsis through calculated despair.

As an added feature, the jukebox periodically generates melancholic playlists based on local weather forecasts, guaranteeing maximum misery during torrential downpours or sweltering heatwaves.

Categories: music, gadgets

items.title: Product of the Day — AI-Enabled Toilet Brush With Blockchain Enhancement
items.text:
This toilet brush features advanced AI-powered bristles that adapt to optimal cleaning patterns based on water pressure fluctuations. Additionally, each use records transactional data onto an internal blockchain ledger, providing users with real-time insights into their personal hygiene habits. The enhanced brush head also incorporates micro-gold particles for improved glaze resistance and scouring efficiency.

As transactions accumulate, users may unlock premium clean modes and special scrubbing protocols tailored to specific bathroom fixtures. All recorded data remains secure within the onboard cryptocurrency wallet, accessible via Bluetooth sync with mobile devices.

Categories: poo
